caption.instagram:
You're paying every month for things you forgot you have.

Streaming $15.99, another one $11.99, music $10.99, cloud $2.99, a gym you last visited in August $40. That's $82 a month. Almost $1,000 a year.

The 5-minute check:
1. Open your bank app, find every amount that repeats, write it down
2. Next to each: did I use this in the last 30 days?
3. Cancel every no. Today, not "on the 1st"

$82 a month becomes $30. Over $600 a year back.

Send this to the friend with four streaming apps.
